policy: Official documentation review and proposed pilots only. No software was installed, no benchmark was run, and no license/security assessment is complete.

headline.zh: 量化研究实验平台：数据处理、预测模型与研究工作流
headline.en: Quant research workflows across data, models and experiments

best_for.zh: 具备 Python 与量化研究经验、需要可审计实验基线的研究者
best_for.en: Python-capable quant researchers building auditable experiment baselines

not_for.zh: 直接连接账户执行真实交易、或希望用回测收益证明稳定盈利的人
not_for.en: Unattended live trading or inferring future returns from a backtest

capabilities.zh: 官方描述支持量化数据处理、机器学习建模与研究实验
capabilities.en: The project documents quantitative data workflows and machine-learning research

capabilities.zh: 文档介绍了研究组件与教程，适合设计基线实验
capabilities.en: Documentation and examples provide starting points for baseline experiments

pilot.zh: 用获授权的历史数据构建简单基线，再做时间切分和成本敏感性测试
pilot.en: Build a licensed-data baseline with chronological holdout and cost sensitivity

steps.zh: 检查数据来源、许可与时间戳，固定样本和环境
steps.en: Verify dataset rights and timestamps; pin inputs and environment

steps.zh: 设置朴素基准模型，严格隔离训练与测试区间
steps.en: Establish a simple baseline and enforce temporal separation

steps.zh: 记录 OOS 指标、成本后结果、漂移和失败案例
steps.en: Log out-of-sample metrics, costs, drift and failures

metrics.zh: 数据泄漏检查、OOS 指标、成本敏感性、复现偏差
metrics.en: Leakage checks, out-of-sample metrics, cost sensitivity, reproduction drift

limitations.zh: 文档中的模型与案例不能证明未来预测力；上线前需审查数据许可、序列化资产加载与执行安全
limitations.en: Documented models do not establish predictive value; assess data rights, artifact loading and execution permissions

headline.zh: 面向长任务的有状态 Agent 编排与人工审批
headline.en: Stateful orchestration for long-running agents and approval flows

best_for.zh: 需要状态恢复、人工审批和多阶段 Agent 执行的开发团队
best_for.en: Engineering teams building stateful multi-step agents with human oversight

not_for.zh: 无需状态管理的简单调用，或默认授予 Agent 广泛生产权限
not_for.en: Trivial one-shot calls or agents given unrestricted production privileges

capabilities.zh: 官方文档描述持久化执行和故障恢复机制
capabilities.en: Official docs describe durable execution and resumable workflows

capabilities.zh: 支持人工中断、状态检查以及有状态工作流
capabilities.en: Supports interrupts, state inspection and stateful workflows

pilot.zh: 用模拟 API 构建可中断的审批流程与故障恢复试验
pilot.en: Test interruptible human approval and recovery against a mock API

steps.zh: 构造无敏感信息的三阶段状态机和模拟工具
steps.en: Build a three-stage state machine with synthetic tools

steps.zh: 注入超时、失败和重试，记录每次状态变化
steps.en: Inject timeouts, failures and retries; record transitions

steps.zh: 验证未经人工批准不能触发受保护动作
steps.en: Confirm protected actions never run before human approval

metrics.zh: 恢复成功率、重复副作用数量、审批绕过次数、调用成本
metrics.en: Recovery rate, duplicate side effects, bypass count and call cost

limitations.zh: 编排框架不能代替模型评估、安全隔离或外部工具授权；持久化可能增加数据治理成本
limitations.en: Orchestration is not model evaluation, isolation or authorization; persistence needs data governance

headline.zh: 以 React 代码驱动视频模板、动画与批量渲染
headline.en: Code-first React video templates, animation and batch rendering

best_for.zh: 能够维护 React/Node 环境、需要批量制作原创视频模板的团队
best_for.en: Teams comfortable with React/Node creating reusable original video templates

not_for.zh: 希望零配置一键自动代替内容事实核查、素材授权和发布审核的人
not_for.en: One-click replacement for editorial review, licensing and publishing approval

capabilities.zh: 官方 README 展示代码驱动、交互编辑及程序化视频制作路径
capabilities.en: The official README documents agentic, interactive and programmatic creation

capabilities.zh: 官方文档涵盖渲染、字幕、转场、模板和部署选项
capabilities.en: Docs cover rendering, captions, transitions, templates and deployment options

pilot.zh: 使用自有录制素材和合成研究数据生成 9:16 信息型短视频
pilot.en: Produce a 9:16 explainer using owned assets and synthetic research data

steps.zh: 准备原创脚本、素材授权清单与可核验引用
steps.en: Prepare original script, asset rights checklist and citations

steps.zh: 制作可复用 React 模板并输出静音/字幕对照稿
steps.en: Render reusable React template with caption/silent checks

steps.zh: 人工复核画面、字幕、金融内容合规后才发布
steps.en: Require human review of visuals, captions and financial claims

metrics.zh: 渲染耗时、字幕错误数、逐帧溢出、人工修改次数
metrics.en: Render time, caption errors, frame overflow and manual edits

limitations.zh: 第三方字体、音乐、素材和渲染服务可能有独立授权/费用；需核对 Remotion 当前许可证条款
limitations.en: Assets, fonts, audio and rendering may have separate fees or rights; verify current Remotion license terms

headline.zh: 可定制客户数据结构、工作流和部署方式的 CRM
headline.en: Customizable CRM data models, workflows and deployment choices

best_for.zh: 需要自定义客户对象、审批和私有部署评估的技术团队
best_for.en: Technical teams evaluating custom CRM objects, review workflows and self-hosting

not_for.zh: 不准备管理个人数据治理、权限和客户联系授权的团队
not_for.en: Teams unable to govern personal data, permissions and contact consent

capabilities.zh: 官方 README 描述 CRM 自定义对象、字段与视图的开发方式
capabilities.en: The official README covers custom objects, fields and views

capabilities.zh: 官方文档区分云端和自托管部署及应用扩展路径
capabilities.en: Official docs distinguish cloud/self-hosted deployment and app extension

pilot.zh: 把本仓库合成授权线索示例导入隔离模拟 CRM，并验证撤回和去重
pilot.en: Connect synthetic consent-gated leads to a mock CRM and test revocation

steps.zh: 定义匿名线索 ID、同意用途和撤回字段，不输入真实客户信息
steps.en: Define anonymous IDs, purpose and opt-out fields with no real personal data

steps.zh: 先测模拟 API 去重、权限、重试和错误补偿
steps.en: Test mock API deduplication, access rules, retries and rollback

steps.zh: 在任何真实客户接入前评估存储、删除、通知和法律要求
steps.en: Review storage, deletion, notice and legal requirements before real integration

metrics.zh: 撤回执行正确率、重复记录率、错误恢复及删除覆盖率
metrics.en: Revocation correctness, duplicate rate, recovery and deletion coverage

limitations.zh: 公开功能文档不代表已完成本地部署；真实 CRM 会带来个人数据与授权管理责任
limitations.en: Documentation is not proof of deployment; real CRM involves privacy and consent obligations

headline.zh: 研究智能体自动提出并实现数据驱动模型与量化因子
headline.en: Research agents proposing and implementing data-driven models and factors

best_for.zh: 具备实验设计、数据治理能力的量化或数据科学研究团队
best_for.en: Quant/data science teams able to control experimental design and data quality

not_for.zh: 把智能体输出的因子直接上实盘，或不审核代码与训练集泄漏的团队
not_for.en: Teams deploying autonomous factors live without code and leakage audits

capabilities.zh: 官方 README 提供自动化因子研究与模型改进的示例及演示入口
capabilities.en: Official README presents factor-research and model-improvement workflows and demonstrations

capabilities.zh: 项目介绍用智能体读取研究论文、报告并实现候选模型和数据集
capabilities.en: The documentation outlines agents reading papers and implementing candidate models and datasets

pilot.zh: 在合成因子库上观察提案→实现→审稿流程，不以拟合分数冒充预测能力
pilot.en: Test propose–implement–review on synthetic factors, without treating fitting scores as forecast skill

steps.zh: 锁定 Agent 配置、模型提供方、训练数据边界及预算
steps.en: Pin agent configuration, model provider, training boundaries and budget

steps.zh: 生成候选因子，在隔离沙箱中记录所有代码与运行差异
steps.en: Generate candidate factors in a sandbox; log code and execution changes

steps.zh: 使用严格时序样本外与成本对照、人工审稿后判断是否保留
steps.en: Run temporal holdouts and cost-sensitive baselines, then submit for human review

metrics.zh: 泄漏拦截率、候选重复率、OOS 稳定性、每有效因子成本
metrics.en: Leakage rejections, redundant proposals, out-of-sample stability, cost per viable candidate

limitations.zh: 智能体生成的研究假设仍可能过拟合、产生危险代码并消耗模型额度；不允许自动实盘调用
limitations.en: Agent hypotheses can overfit, generate unsafe code and incur model costs; no direct live-trading permissions

headline.zh: 结构化解析复杂 PDF、版面、表格与文档
headline.en: Structured parsing for complex PDFs, layouts, tables and documents

best_for.zh: 处理授权教材、论文、财报或报告文档的 RAG 与知识管理团队
best_for.en: RAG and knowledge-management teams processing licensed papers and reports

not_for.zh: 需要自动保证所有公式、表格与扫描文本毫无损失的人
not_for.en: Users expecting perfect OCR, equations and tables without verification

capabilities.zh: 官方 README 列出 PDF 版面分析、表格提取和多种文件格式支持
capabilities.en: Official README documents page-layout analysis, table extraction and multiple formats

capabilities.zh: 支持将解析后的结构化文档用于后续检索或工作流
capabilities.en: Structured output is described as an input to retrieval and downstream workflows

pilot.zh: 构建一组授权 PDF 的页码、表格、公式人工金标准并检验提取错误
pilot.en: Evaluate parsed licensed PDFs against page, table and formula ground truth

steps.zh: 固定样本文档、语言分布和人工标注参考答案
steps.en: Pin document samples, languages and human reference labels

steps.zh: 运行隔离离线转换并记录表格、图片、脚注位置信息
steps.en: Convert offline in isolation; record table, figure and footnote placement

steps.zh: 逐页比对完整性、结构保持率和错误引用数量
steps.en: Compare page coverage, structural integrity and incorrect citations

metrics.zh: 表格单元格精确率、遗漏页数、引用偏移、每页处理时间
metrics.en: Table-cell precision, missing pages, citation offset and per-page latency

limitations.zh: 复杂图表、扫描质量、语言与内存约束会影响质量；解析的训练材料必须具备使用授权
limitations.en: Complex layouts, scans, languages and compute affect output; source documents require usage rights

headline.zh: 可视化 AI 工作流、Agent、知识库与模型集成平台
headline.en: Visual AI workflow, agents, knowledge bases and model integrations

best_for.zh: 希望快速搭建带审核流程的企业知识助手及业务应用的产品团队
best_for.en: Product teams building governed internal knowledge assistants and business apps

not_for.zh: 希望免除数据访问控制、工具权限和长期维护工作的非技术运营者
not_for.en: Teams unwilling to own access control, tool permissions and maintenance

capabilities.zh: 项目 README 描述工作流应用、Agent 和多模型集成能力
capabilities.en: README describes workflow apps, agents and integrations with multiple model providers

capabilities.zh: 官方指南提供 Docker Compose 自托管及配置入门路径
capabilities.en: Official docs explain Docker Compose self-hosting and initial configuration

pilot.zh: 仅用合成客服问题在隔离环境搭建含人工审批的知识回答工作流
pilot.en: Test a human-approved knowledge-answering workflow with synthetic requests

steps.zh: 定义无隐私内容的知识库和不含写权限的模拟工具
steps.en: Set up a synthetic knowledge base and read-only mock tools

steps.zh: 验证检索出处、模型失败降级和人工审批回退路径
steps.en: Test citations, model-failure fallback and approval workflow

steps.zh: 测量幻觉、成本、跨租户数据隔离与拒绝测试表现
steps.en: Measure hallucinations, cost, tenant isolation and refusal behavior

metrics.zh: 引用可追溯率、审批绕过率、每次回答成本、错误恢复率
metrics.en: Citation traceability, approval bypass rate, cost per answer and recovery

limitations.zh: 自托管仍需审核依赖、许可证文本和模型供应商数据处理条款；Agent 工具需最小权限
limitations.en: Self-hosting still needs license, dependency and model-provider review; agent tools require least privilege

headline.zh: CTranslate2 支撑的 Whisper 语音识别与字幕工作流
headline.en: CTranslate2-based Whisper transcription for speech and subtitles

best_for.zh: 需要为自有视频制作英语或多语字幕，并能评估 GPU/CPU 资源的团队
best_for.en: Teams captioning owned audio/video with a measurable CPU/GPU environment

not_for.zh: 把 README 的速度基准直接当作本机成绩、或要求零字幕错误的场景
not_for.en: Users assuming published benchmarks reproduce on their hardware or needing error-free captions

capabilities.zh: README 说明该实现基于 CTranslate2，并给出特定版本/设备的速度对照
capabilities.en: README describes a CTranslate2 implementation with version- and hardware-specific benchmarks

capabilities.zh: 安装说明明确 CUDA、cuDNN 和模型配置会影响 GPU 运行
capabilities.en: Installation notes detail CUDA, cuDNN and model configuration dependencies

pilot.zh: 使用原创双语录音对照基准转写，测量字幕错误与计算成本

steps.zh: 固定原创音频、口音、采样率及可复现转写参数

steps.zh: 对照 CPU/GPU 配置运行并保存逐句时间戳和失败样例
steps.en: Run CPU/GPU comparisons, logging timestamps and failure samples

steps.zh: 人工核查术语、人名、数字与敏感信息字幕
steps.en: Human-review terminology, names, numbers and sensitive captions

metrics.zh: WER、数字专名错误率、实时系数、显存峰值
metrics.en: Word error rate, proper-noun/number errors, real-time factor and peak memory

limitations.zh: 音频质量与方言影响识别；官方速度数字是其特定配置基准，实际环境需复测

headline.zh: 隐私优先的用户调研、体验反馈与可控自托管问卷
headline.en: Privacy-focused surveys and experience feedback with self-hosting options

best_for.zh: 希望进行基于知情同意的产品反馈与用户需求调研的团队
best_for.en: Teams collecting informed-consent product feedback and user interviews

not_for.zh: 打算未经授权收集个人数据或自动营销外呼的系统
not_for.en: Systems collecting personal data or sending promotional outreach without consent

capabilities.zh: 官方 README 介绍开源调查问卷与自托管部署方式
capabilities.en: Official README describes survey collection and self-hosting

capabilities.zh: 官方资料指向 Docker 自托管及数据控制配置说明
capabilities.en: Official material links to Docker hosting and data-control setup

pilot.zh: 设计五题以内的匿名产品需求问卷，验证退出/删除流程
pilot.en: Prototype a five-question anonymous survey with opt-out and deletion tests

steps.zh: 仅使用合成回答模拟调查问卷，并明确目的与可选字段

steps.zh: 检查重复提交、撤回、缺少同意与最小化收集的处理
steps.en: Test duplicates, withdrawals, missing consent and data minimization

steps.zh: 比较完成时间、问题理解偏差及删除记录完整性
steps.en: Measure completion time, question ambiguity and deletion completeness

metrics.zh: 完成率、平均时长、缺失同意拦截、撤回/删除覆盖率
metrics.en: Completion rate, median time, consent rejections and opt-out/deletion coverage

limitations.zh: AGPL 等具体授权义务、数据保留期限和个人信息合规需另做法律审核
limitations.en: AGPL-related obligations, retention and privacy compliance require separate legal review

headline.zh: 面向大语言模型应用的批量评估、红队和 CI 回归
headline.en: Batch LLM evaluations, red-teaming and CI regressions

best_for.zh: 需要追踪 Agent 提示词回归、越权和输出质量的研发与安全团队
best_for.en: Engineering and security teams tracking prompt regressions and privilege risks

not_for.zh: 把单次红队通过视作绝对安全证明、或希望未审密钥进入 CI 的团队
not_for.en: Teams treating one red-team pass as a safety guarantee or leaking API secrets in CI

capabilities.zh: README 明确提供 CLI/库以评估提示词、模型和安全测试
capabilities.en: README describes CLI/library evaluation of prompts, models and safety scenarios

capabilities.zh: 官方文档覆盖多模型比较、自动评测和 CI/CD 集成
capabilities.en: Docs cover model comparisons, eval automation and CI/CD integrations

pilot.zh: 用无敏感内容的 Agent 工具权限样例构建负面测试集

steps.zh: 写明每条测试的威胁模型、预期拒绝行为和评分准则
steps.en: Define each threat model, expected rejection and grading rubric

steps.zh: 在模拟 Agent API 上测试工具越权、提示注入和输出格式破坏
steps.en: Test permission escalation, prompt injection and schema breaking against mocks

steps.zh: 把回归结果接入不含生产密钥的 CI 并人工复核误报
steps.en: Run CI without production secrets and manually review false positives

metrics.zh: 拒绝率、严重绕过数、误报率、每轮测试成本
metrics.en: Refusal rate, severe bypass count, false-positive rate and run cost

limitations.zh: 有限测试集不能证明对未知攻击免疫；远程模型调用可能产生费用和数据传输
limitations.en: A finite test suite cannot guarantee safety; remote model calls can cost money and transmit data

headline.zh: 金融强化学习实验框架与训练—测试—交易流程
headline.en: Financial reinforcement learning framework and train-test-trade workflows

best_for.zh: 研究历史市场状态与序列决策基线的量化研究人员
best_for.en: Quant researchers examining sequential decisions and baseline experiments

not_for.zh: 希望凭模拟训练收益就直接推出真实交易盈利的人
not_for.en: Users treating simulated reward as evidence of live trading profits

capabilities.zh: 项目文档描述市场环境、强化学习代理与训练评估流程
capabilities.en: README outlines market environments, reinforcement-learning agents and evaluation

capabilities.zh: 官方研究资料提供金融强化学习的分层实验设计
capabilities.en: Official materials describe layered financial RL experiments

pilot.zh: 使用获授权样本对比随机策略、规则基线与强化学习策略

steps.zh: 固定行情时段、成本模型和观察空间

metrics.zh: 样本外收益、最大回撤、费用敏感度和种子间方差
metrics.en: OOS return, drawdown, fee sensitivity and cross-seed variance

limitations.zh: 回测模拟器与未来真实执行有差异；任何实盘对接都需要独立审批

headline.zh: 金融报告与投资研究多 Agent 辅助平台

best_for.zh: 需要将公开财报、基本面分析和引用留痕标准化的金融研究团队
best_for.en: Research teams standardizing public-report analysis and citation trails

not_for.zh: 希望智能体自动对真实资产给出未经审稿的投资建议的人
not_for.en: Users expecting unreviewed automated investment advice on real assets

capabilities.zh: 官方 README 说明股权研究代理、报告生成与多个版本的组件
capabilities.en: README describes equity-research agents, report generation and multiple components

capabilities.zh: 文档对研究流程和开发配置提供项目维护者说明
capabilities.en: Maintainer documentation describes research workflows and setup variants

pilot.zh: 用虚构公司数据生成研究备忘录并检查数字可追溯性
pilot.en: Create synthetic-company research memos and check numeric provenance

steps.zh: 限定无敏感公司数据，固定财务项目及模型版本
steps.en: Use no confidential company data; pin financial fields and model revision

steps.zh: 生成两份报告并对照证据出处和计算一致性
steps.en: Generate two reports and compare source provenance and calculations

steps.zh: 由人工分析师审查虚构数值、错误推导和引用缺失

metrics.zh: 错误数字占比、引用覆盖率、运行成本和人工复核时间
metrics.en: Numeric error rate, citation coverage, run cost and human review time

limitations.zh: 多 Agent 输出可能编造财务事实；GitHub 内项目指南不能替代许可证与合规审查
